title: Rate Plan Inclusions Schedule: Valet Bonus per Night on Member and Corporate Rates (Guest Folios)
content:
Two rate plans of Room Reservations include a valet bonus per night on the Ashbury Rewards valet savings posted to Guest Folios.

**Inclusion.** Rate-plan valet bonus: a reservation on the Member Flexible Rate adds the member-rate valet bonus of $1.50 per night, one on the Corporate Negotiated Rate adds the corporate-rate valet bonus of $1.00 per night, and one on any other rate plan adds nothing. The bonus is added to the nightly valet saving, and that per-night figure is then taken for each valet line of the stay.

The rate plan is the rate plan on the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio.

| Rate plan on the Room Reservations record | Valet bonus per night |
|---|---|
| Member Flexible Rate | $1.50 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | $1.00 |
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, Semi-Flexible Saver Rate, Flexible Rate, Bed & Breakfast Package Rate, Group Block Rate or Reward Night Rate | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical nightly saving and valet lines)

| Rate plan | Hypothetical nightly saving | Bonus | Per-night figure | Valet lines | Stay figure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member Flexible Rate | $2.40 | $1.50 | $3.90 | 4 | $15.60 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | $2.40 | $1.00 | $3.40 | 4 | $13.60 |
| Flexible Rate | $2.40 | None | $2.40 | 4 | $9.60 |
